name: adpilot-ai
description: AdPilot AI - AI-powered e-commerce advertising creative generation platform

scripts.dev:agent: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path agent/.venv/Scripts/python.exe) { & agent/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload --app-dir agent } else { python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload --app-dir agent }"
scripts.test:agent: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path agent/.venv/Scripts/pytest.exe) { & agent/.venv/Scripts/pytest.exe agent/tests -v } else { pytest agent/tests -v }"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run build:frontend

author: AdPilot AI Team
